name: FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]
description: FLUX.1 Kontext [pro] creates and edits images from text prompts with strong character and style consistency.

prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation or editing.

input_image.description: Optional base64 encoded image or URL to edit.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, from 3:7 to 7:3. Defaults to 1:1.

prompt_upsampling.description: Whether to upsample the prompt. Defaults to false.

safety_tolerance.description: Moderation tolerance. 0 is strictest and 6 is most permissive.

output_format.description: Output image format. Defaults to jpeg.

input.prompt: A small furry elephant pet looks out from a cat house
A remote gas station swallowed by crimson fog, green glow from overhead lights staining the asphalt, cinematic wide shot
